function.arguments: {"observation": "The `channel` column has only two values: 'email' and 'paid_search'. However, the email campaign was deliberately targeted at existing high-value customers (loyal and returning), while paid_search reached new customers. This means the channel is not randomly assigned and is confounded with customer_segment.", "implication": "Any raw comparison of conversion rates between channels would be confounded by customer_segment. We cannot compute 'conversion rate among new customers reached by paid_search' by simply filtering on channel and averaging converted — because the 'new' group is entirely defined by the channel. We must isolate the 'new' segment within 'paid_search' and compute conversion only within that group."}
function.name: note_finding
